title: razzmataisse-ags config
description: Non-visual settings for the shell, bridged into src/ as `@config`.

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema file for autocomplete/validation.

grepCommand.description: The ripgrep-compatible binary used for the search panel's file search (name on $PATH, or an absolute path).

ignoredDesktopEntries.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns (`*` wildcard only) matched against both a .desktop file's id and its display name -- matching apps are hidden from search entirely.

ignoreGlobs.description: ripgrep --iglob patterns excluded from the file search under $HOME. A leading "!" excludes; bare names (no slash) match at any depth.
